This is the actual main_mc -> mc active ninja1 NPC timeline. The reused library
name 一护全动作 does NOT make ninja1 the playable Ichigo character.
main_mc.xml defineAction k1/k2/k3 supplies power30/30/50, hitType2/2/6,
hurtType0/0/1, hitx0/0/3, hity0/0/0, hurtTime0 and isBreakDef=false.
HitVO declared defaults are applied explicitly and preserved with authored raw
fields. The raw isWeak=true field is not a declared runtime HitVO property;
it is retained for provenance but is not invented as an effective gameplay flag.
Runtime weak-hit evaluation remains HitVO.isWeakHit(), not this authored field.

XFL zero-based action frames (Flash currentFrame=XFL index+1), 30Hz:
  normal1 label index149, hit k1atm151..152 = relative2..3,
    setAttack("砍2") index155 = relative6,
    endAct index160 = relative11, idle index169 = relative20.
  normal2 label index172, hit k2atm176..177 = relative4..5,
    setAttack("砍3") index181 = relative9,
    endAct index187 = relative15, idle index199 = relative27.
  normal3 label index203, hit k3atm207..208 = relative4..5,
    endAct index214 = relative11, idle index228 = relative25.
Cancel windows are half-open [6,11) and [9,15). No authored hit-confirm
condition guards these setAttack calls. Do not grant J for the whole recovery.
The label spans23/31/32 are NOT the actual durations: idle jumps away earlier.
Actionable durations are20/27/25 source ticks, with2/2/2 active ticks.

Source movement entry events are also preserved:
  normal1 rel1 movePercent(1,0), dampingPercent(.2,0)
  normal2 rel3 movePercent(.5,0), dampingPercent(.1,0)
  normal3 rel0 movePercent(1,0), dampingPercent(.1,0)
The caller applies these once on entering frames. The module does not integrate
velocity, automatically buffer input, require contact or redraw character art.

Upstream AS3 mechanism:
FighterMcCtrler.as:352-359 setAttack sets a permitted attack label if present.
FighterMcCtrler.as:563-572 endAct clears action slots and enters FREEZE.
FighterMcCtrler.as:166-217 idle clears states and restores all permitted actions.
FighterAction.as:99-140 clearAction clears attack/skill/defense/etc slots.
FighterHitModel.as:61-74 maps k1atm to defineAction("k1").
FighterMC.as:460-487 reads bdmn bounds;491-535 reads hit instances per frame
with getBounds(_fighterDisplay). There is no single permanently enabled hitbox.

Exact extracted geometry:
Helper 0面 is an unstroked transparent rectangle65.95x40.5 sourcepx (twips/20).
Body matrix a=.313735961914063,d=1.37767028808594,tx=-11.25,ty=-31.9.
Body rect [-11.25,-31.9,20.690886688232457,55.79564666748057].
Attack source rectangles/matrices are stored verbatim in the derived JSON.
The Godot meme adapter subtracts body centre-x/bottom-y and uses ONE uniform
scale target_body_height /55.79564666748057. Both axes use that scale, then
facing mirrors around the foot origin. Target height is already world px;
do not multiply by stageunit1.6 again. The raw source coordinates remain intact.
This body-height registration is explicitly the meme-art adapter, not an
additional original BVN rule. It keeps original geometric proportions, while
individual meme visual extremities must still be aligned in their pose keys.

Public scope checked via pinned recursive Git tree (22,115 entries; not truncated):
11 complete public fighter documents, all zako NPCs. There are no non-zako
fighter paths, packaged formal-character ZIP/7Z/RAR/SWF or character FLA files.
The only5 FLA blobs are fonts. No art/bitmap/DAT/sound/FLA/SWF was downloaded.
Public source NPCs include real limited attacks (ninja1 three-hit chain;
ninja_earth/fire/sand/thunder two-hit plus specific 招1; bear/dog/bird/pig 招1).
They do not supply a complete30-action main-playable fighter ruleset.
A dormant 一护万解全动作.xml has35 legacy labels and Key.isDown/_root/ql AS2
scripts, but is not referenced by current main_mc, uses no current AS3 controller
and contains0 defineAction records. Do not silently treat it as current AS3
main-character metadata or guess its missing HitVO definitions.

Five memes may share these explicitly labelled PUBLIC-NPC-NORMAL baseline
rules while keeping original identities and authored pose assets. SJ/WJ/U/SU/WU/
I/SI/WI and air skills remain authored resource adapters until complete public
source timelines for them can be independently resolved. They should use the
same clear/set permission model, but must not be called sourced character data.

Important combo scope: this NPC defines a THREE-ATTACK INPUT CHAIN, not a
guaranteed playable-main-character true combo. With authored hurtTime0 and
current source hurt-resume logic, a defender may recover before the next
permitted attack becomes active. Do not silently increase hurtTime or advertise
this NPC baseline as the full playable BVN character combat template. All10
other actual public NPC entrypoints were also inspected: none supplies a
three-part playable timeline or a nonzero authored hurtTime. dog1 HitType.KAN
gets a constructor floor of100ms, but has only a single attack. See
source_reference/bvn-flash-logic/public-npc-coverage.json for the complete scan.

VISUAL ADAPTER BOUNDARY (not original rule data)
The current meme layered-pose renderer has authored normalized visual progress,
not the source character's original animation frames. Generic .45/.62 phase
boundaries are therefore not evidence of source animation/contact equivalence.
Applied piecewise mapping in Fighter._normal_pose_progress below aligns the two source active ticks with
existing contact pose keys, without changing the permission or damage clocks:
  normal1 source relative frames 0,1,2,3,4,6,11,20
    visual progress             0,.286,.429,.571,.714,.80,.90,1
  normal2 source relative frames 0,2,4,5,6,9,15,27
    visual progress             0,.222,.444,.556,.667,.80,.90,1
  normal3 source relative frames 0,3,4,5,6,11,25
    visual progress             0,.273,.455,.545,.636,.85,1
Interpolate only the visual pose between these knots. Gameplay samples raw source
frames; setAttack windows remain [6,11)/[9,15), and endAct/idle remain unchanged.
This visual adapter is applied by Fighter._normal_pose_progress; it does not alter source gameplay frames.

Timing alignment alone does not resolve every authored meme extremity. The Rio
giant sword can reach about400 worldpx while the scaled NPC normal1 rectangle
ends about141px in front of the foot. The longer weapon therefore needs an
explicitly labelled hit-geometry/pose adapter if its entire painted blade is to
damage. The source raw rectangle must remain available for audit. Cat/chicken
paw, shark shoe and worker bag tips also need pose-relative visual verification;
clamping a spark to the logical overlap does not prove the painted weapon fits.
No original character art or additional main-character timeline is implied.
